doc.title: Bela Fleck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, December 7, 2004

title: Closing remarks and Nashville
summary: Rowe thanks Fleck, who says no question is left unasked and Nashville is home though he is rarely there. They say goodbye before the evening concert.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well I appreciate your time today.
It was fun talking about it, I don’t get to very often.
In all the interviews you’ve ever done is there a question that you’d like to be asked that no one’s asked?
Okay. I just thought I would —
No people ask me that too and I just tend to be responsive and go wherever it goes.
When you can get back there.
Well I’ll look forward to hearing you tonight, and I hope your year off is really productive.
Yeah I think it’s going to be really fun and I’m going to miss the guys too.
All right thanks for your time.
